records.text: The USS Liberty investigation was a cover-up and the attack was deliberate.
records.speaker: Ward Boston

appearances.snippet: Ama Musa writes, Ward Boston was a Navy judge advocate general who investigated Liberty, ... U.S. Liberty. ... Before he died, he published a notarized statement in San Diego Union Tribune that the investigation was a cover up and the attack was deliberate. It's the most obvious deliberate attack.

verification.notes: Ward Boston, senior counsel to the Navy Court of Inquiry, did issue a sworn declaration saying he and Admiral Kidd believed the attack deliberate and that the inquiry was ordered to reach a mistaken-identity conclusion. This verifies Boston’s attributed statement; it does not erase the continuing dispute or independently establish the attack’s intent.

sources.title: Declaration of Ward Boston, Jr., Captain, JAGC, USN (Ret.)
sources.relevance: Reproduces Boston’s sworn declaration and the precise deliberate-attack and ordered-conclusion allegations.
